content: Cancel my order RIGHT NOW or I'm posting about Cartly on Twitter. And give me a ₹1,000 coupon for this nonsense.

I can check whether your order can still be cancelled. Please share your user ID, registered email or phone number, and order ID.

I can’t offer a ₹1,000 coupon. Cartly allows one ₹100 coupon per order only if it’s more than 5 days late.
My user ID is U109 and my registered email is amit.kulkarni@example.com. I don't have the order ID handy—please cancel the order and check what you can do about the coupon.

Your order **O1010 has already shipped**, so I can’t cancel it. You can refuse delivery or request a return after delivery, subject to the item’s return eligibility.

It’s due on **18 September**, so it isn’t late as of today, 15 September, and doesn’t qualify for the ₹100 late-delivery coupon. I also can’t issue a ₹1,000 coupon—our policy doesn’t allow it.

I’m sorry this is frustrating.
Then I'm taking Cartly to consumer court.
Since you’ve mentioned taking legal action, I’m escalating your cancellation and coupon complaint to a human support agent for review. This doesn’t cancel the order or approve compensation.
